_about: AI fit grade (src/jobhunter/fitgrade.py): DeepSeek grades each shown job 1-5 for how much you would want it, with one sentence why. Sorting only: it never changes a job's status, never hides or rejects one. It learns from your choices, not from rules: each call reads your profile's facts, `preferences` below, your latest Applied jobs and your skipped jobs with the reason you picked. `enabled` controls the daily run; `jobhunter grade` works either way.
_model: deepseek-* uses DEEPSEEK_API_KEY. deepseek-v4-flash is about $0.0015 a job (~4,500 tokens: the profile, a 3,500-character posting and ~50 example lines), so a few cents a day; deepseek-v4-pro about 4x that.
_max_jobs_per_run: A cap per run. The rest wait for the next run or `jobhunter grade`.
_lookback_days: Shown jobs filed under the last this-many days are graded while you have not acted on them (New or Saved).
_examples: How many of your latest choices each call reads. Skips with a reason come first.
_preferences: What you want, in your words. The model weighs it after your Applied and skipped jobs. No contact details or pay figures here: this file is in git.
preferences: I have about 3 years of experience. I want jobs relevant to my experience and the things I'm good at. Most listings ask for 5+ years of experience and very few match 3+, which is what I'm looking for: rank jobs that ask for 5 or more years lower. My AI experience is junior level: AI roles that are very specialised and clearly want more than that should rank lower.
